accepted_statement: For q>5 prime, N=5q and every primitive complex Nth root zeta, arbitrary binary square fixed-phase masks have either scalar Gram dI exactly at d in {0,1,5,q,5q}.
d0: Only the zero mask; s=N is vacuous and directly has M=F, error zero
dN: Only the full mask; s=0 has no invertible admissible M
inverse_row_domain: Integers 1<=s<=5q-1; normalized complex Fourier target; every inverse row has at most s nonzeros; arbitrary complex invertible M
